Name: Seasonal Hats (Json Assets)
Author: beeeans
Description:
[b]Requirements:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Smapi
[*]Content Patcher
[*]Json Assets

[/list]
[b]How to Install: [/b][list=1]
[*]Download and install the latest versions of Smapi and Content Patcher
[*]Install [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/mediawiki/index.php?title=Modding:SMAPI_compatibility&oldid=74245#Json_Assets]Json Assets[/url]﻿
[*]Download seasonal hats mod and unzip. Place unzipped folder inside Stardewvalley/Mods
[*]Enjoy!
[/list]
[b]How to Uninstall:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Delete all seasonal hats purchased in the game first

[*]Delete Seasonal Hats mod from mods folder
[*]Delete Json Assets folder (unless you have other mods that requires this)

[/list]
[b]Credits:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Special thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/53667001]Seyph[/url] for giving us permission to use their codes/files/art as basis for our mod.
[*]The bird and the flower crown on the straw hat was borrowed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/64]Yuikami's Kawaii Hats mod[/url]﻿. If the mod creator sees this and doesn't approve, please let us know. :)
[*]The red flower crown has flowers borrowed from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/891]Eemie's craftable flowers mod[/url]﻿. If the mod creator sees this and doesn't approve, please let us know. :)
[*]Flower crowns and base straw hat were created by Maea.

[/list]
